about: BIOS and system files read by the libretro cores embedded in NeoStation iOS (Build 438). Public sizes and checksums only, never BIOS bytes. Read by lib/services/libretro_bios_catalog.dart and checked by test/libretro_bios_requirements_test.py.

sources.coreSourcesNote: identity.json records no source commit: these are the last commits on or before the pinned cores run (the buildbot rebuilds nightly). test/libretro_bios_requirements_test.py --cores checks the file names against the pinned binaries.

flags.beetleOpenBiosFallbackEvidence: beetle-psx-libretro libretro.c falls back to the built-in OpenBIOS (deps/openbios) when no region BIOS is found (upstream change 5da5a3e9c9, 2026-03-28). The same upstream commit adds the override_bios option value openbios; the --cores strings check requires that value in both pinned PS1 binaries (an indirect check: it shows the commit is in the build, not the fallback code itself).
